title: Business Governance, Reports & Private Documents
principles: Normal POS sales must remain immediate and must not require owner approval.
Sensitive shared-account money-out actions by a non-account-owner require approval before any financial posting.
Pending approvals must not change account balances, ledgers, budgets, bills, instalments, reports, seller balances or financial status.
Incoming customer payments such as normal POS sales and invoice receipts do not require approval by default.
Confidential payslip and seller payout documents must never be visible to unrelated Space members.

requirements: Shared Business accounts can be assigned to selected Space members.
Support account access levels: Owner, Manager, User and Viewer.
Keep granular permissions for account use, balance visibility and ledger/activity visibility.
Shared accounts appear in global Accounts and Money views when the signed-in user has permission.
Account ownership can be transferred safely to another eligible BajetBN user.
Ownership transfer must preserve historical transactions and ledger integrity.
Account owner retains final control over sensitive account actions.
Approval rules are action-based rather than blanket account locking.
Account owner can approve or reject.
Maintain pending, approved, rejected and cancelled audit history.
Notify requester when approved or rejected.
Allow approval policy to be configurable where suitable.
Owner can grant full report access to selected Business Space members independently of their POS role.
A cashier, viewer or other selected member can receive full-report permission without receiving unrelated management permissions.
Report access must be enforced by backend permissions as well as UI.
Split payments must be allocated to their actual payment accounts without double-counting.
Support CSV export.
Support printable reports.
Instalments assigned to a Space must be visible inside that Space.
Bills view shows bills only.
Instalments view shows instalments only.
Show total, paid, remaining, next due date and payment history where applicable.
Keep Business Invoices.
Review owner-only restrictions and support selected authorised users where appropriate.
Creating and issuing invoices follows Business permissions.
Incoming invoice payment normally posts without owner approval.
Sensitive cancellation or financial correction remains restricted and audited.
Replace the user-facing full Payroll concept with Payslips and Salary Documents.
Preserve existing historical payroll and ledger records.
Support monthly payslip generation for Business Space employees.
Support salary, allowance, overtime, bonus, deductions, net pay, payment date, payment method, reference and notes.
Generate a permanent payslip document or PDF.
Generate a private BajetBN payslip link.
Allow WhatsApp sharing using the employee phone number.
Employee can view only their own payslips.
Business Owner can view all payslips.
Only explicitly authorised Managers can view all payslips.
Other staff must never see another employee payslip.
Provide My Payslips inside the relevant Business Space and a private global document view.
Issued documents must keep history; corrections should be reissued rather than silently replacing history.
Generate a settlement or payout statement whenever a Marketplace seller payout is finalised.
Generate a document or PDF and private BajetBN link.
Allow WhatsApp sharing using the seller phone number.
Linked seller can view only their own payout statements.
Business Owner can view all seller payout statements.
Only explicitly authorised Managers can view all payout statements.
Other sellers and unrelated staff must not see another seller payout statement.
Statement includes payout amount, payment account, payment method, reference, balance after payout and relevant adjustments.
Where available, show the sales or earnings covered by the payout.
Use dedicated permission-protected document storage rather than ordinary Space-wide attachment visibility.
Do not expose raw Firebase storage links as the primary shared link.
BajetBN document routes must validate the signed-in viewer.
Owner and authorised manager access must be audited.
Employee or seller access must be identity-linked.
Support issued, shared, viewed, reissued and cancelled document history.
Develop only on feature/v1.14.16-business-governance-reports-documents.
Do not modify production during feature development.
Build and verify every slice before staging.
Test account approval behaviour with owner and non-owner users.
Test confidential document isolation with at least two different staff or seller accounts.
Promote only after staging acceptance.
